verdict.rationale: New Relic's alerting docs mention defining thresholds and who is notified (new-relic-docs-5, new-relic-docs-25), which touches escalation/notification, but there is no evidence of a dedicated incident timeline view, on-call scheduling, or formal escalation-policy management comparable to a dedicated incident-response tool. Missing for 10: documented incident timeline tracking, on-call schedule configuration, and escalation policy chains/rotations.
